integrity: The characterization is proved analytically and independently checked by exhaustive enumeration on representative finite instances. No independence beyond the self-review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to equal-blade generalized windmills with \(k\ge2\) and \(m\ge3\). The friendship boundary \(m=2\) is excluded from the originality claim because published failed-skew-zero-forcing results already cover its qualitative behavior. The foundational article's full text was not available in the inspected public sources, and an earlier month-only preprint listing does not resolve an exact day.
title: Skew zero forcing profile of generalized windmill graphs
